Since the 1970 NFL-AFL merger, league rules were changed to allow the Super Bowl home team to pick their choice of jersey. Most of the time, Dallas will wear their blue jerseys when they visit Washington, Philadelphia (sometimes), Miami, or one of the handful of other teams that traditionally wear their white jerseys at home during the first half of the season due to the hot climates in their respective cities or other means. Occasionally opposing teams will wear their white jerseys at home to try to invoke the curse,[109] such as when the Philadelphia Eagles hosted the Cowboys in the 1980 NFC Championship Game,[110] as well as their November 4, 2007 meeting. Various other teams followed suit in the 1980s.
